净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Mutation of avsi_gen0_a. Preserves size-gated value mechanism but adds smoothing (5-day rolling mean) to cash flow yield and sales yield to reduce noise and improve the raw linear correlation (IC). The leverage penalty on small-cap sales yield is retained. Cross-sectional ranking remains to ensure comparability. Parent strength in RankIC and RankICIR is preserved.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

If size_large: ts_mean(1/pcf_ocf_ttm). If size_small: ts_mean(1/ps_ttm)*(1 - debttoassets/100). Else average.
依赖列: pcf_ocf_ttm, ps_ttm, debttoassets, style_gate_size_large, style_gate_size_small

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. if_else —— 条件选择
    if_else((ts_mean(Volume, 20) > ts_mean(ts_mean(Volume, 20), 60)), ts_mean(divide(1, pcf_ocf_ttm), 20), ts_mean(divide(1, ps_ttm), 20))
  2. 2. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(ts_mean(Volume, 20), 60)
  4. 4. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
  5. 5. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(1, pcf_ocf_ttm), 20)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, pcf_ocf_ttm)
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(1, ps_ttm), 20)
  8. 8. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, ps_ttm)

列含义说明

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
if_else条件选择：condition 为真返回 v1，否则返回 v2

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 cf_yield：1.0 / pcf_ocf_ttm
  2. 计算 sales_yield：1.0 / ps_ttm
  3. 计算 cf_yield_sm：cf_yield.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=3).mean()
  4. 计算 sales_yield_sm：sales_yield.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=3).mean()
  5. 计算 debt_ratio：debttoassets / 100.0
  6. 计算 debt_ratio：debt_ratio.clip(0, 1)
  7. 计算 small_value：sales_yield_sm * (1.0 - debt_ratio)
  8. 计算 large_cond：style_gate_size_large == 1
  9. 计算 small_cond：style_gate_size_small == 1
  10. 计算 neutral：(cf_yield_sm + small_value) / 2.0
  11. 计算 signal：np.where(large_cond, cf_yield_sm, np.where(small_cond, small_value, neutral))
  12. 计算 signal：(cf_yield_sm + small_value) / 2.0

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_size_gated_value_sales_cf_smoothed(df): df_copy = df.copy() "com"># Cash flow yield "kw">class="kw">for large caps (safe inverse of P/CF) cf_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["pcf_ocf_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Sales yield "kw">class="kw">for small caps (safe inverse of P/S) sales_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["ps_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Smooth yields with rolling mean cf_yield_sm = cf_yield.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean() sales_yield_sm = sales_yield.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean() "com"># Leverage penalty "kw">class="kw">for small caps: discount sales yield when debt is high debt_ratio = df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0 debt_ratio = debt_ratio.clip(0, 1) small_value = sales_yield_sm * (1.0 - debt_ratio) "com"># Use style gates: size_large "kw">class="kw">and size_small "kw">class="kw">if "style_gate_size_large" "kw">class="kw">in df_copy.columns "kw">class="kw">and "style_gate_size_small" "kw">class="kw">in df_copy.columns: large_cond = df_copy["style_gate_size_large"] == 1 small_cond = df_copy["style_gate_size_small"] == 1 neutral = (cf_yield_sm + small_value) / 2.0 signal = np.where(large_cond, cf_yield_sm, np.where(small_cond, small_value, neutral)) "kw">class="kw">else: signal = (cf_yield_sm + small_value) / 2.0 df_copy["factor_size_gated_value_sales_cf_smoothed"] = signal "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_size_gated_value_sales_cf_smoothed"]
